title: AGV traffic at pedestrian crossings (synthetic plant SOP)
text: Every AGV route that crosses X-WEST or X-EAST must slow to 0.5 m/s or less from one cell before the crossing until it has left it, and sound the horn. Body carriers are not exempt.

title: Stalled or faulted AGV (synthetic plant SOP)
text: Fence the stalled AGV with a one-cell geofence. Only a person with the agv_reset skill may approach it. Other AGVs must keep two cells away and re-route; a replacement AGV takes over the kit run.

title: Line-side part shortage (synthetic plant SOP)
text: Send the nearest healthy kitting AGV from the supermarket exit (7, 13) to the station's line-side rack. A tugger or forklift may be driven only by a person whose forklift training is in date. The team leader confirms delivery at the station.

title: Fluid spill response (synthetic plant SOP)
text: Fence the spill area with a two-cell geofence and keep AGVs out until it is dry. A person with spill_response brings the nearest spill kit, absorbs, cleans and dries the floor, then releases the area.

title: Machine repair under lockout/tagout (synthetic plant SOP)
text: Before servicing a machine, an authorised maintenance technician with in-date lockout/tagout training isolates every energy source, applies a personal lock and tag, and tries to start the machine to verify zero energy.

title: Machine temperature alarm (synthetic plant SOP)
text: A single temperature alarm that is not confirmed by a second sensor (vibration or air temperature) is verified first: a technician checks the machine before the line is stopped. A confirmed alarm stops the machine and starts SOP-LOTO-01.

title: Robot cell entry (synthetic plant SOP)
text: Enter a robot cell only after stopping the robots, locking the gate open with your own lock, and carrying an in-date robot-cell entry card. Never reach through a guard opening while the cell is in auto.
